decisions.about: The order of content and structure
decisions.decided: a deliverable's rounds make and judge its content by its kind's best practice until each condition is good, and only then does the generator rework its structure by the refactor best practice and an evaluator judge that
a round after the first judges again only the conditions whose decisions changed since the round before
two rounds of content and two of structure at most; a more still left after them goes to the user with the deliverable as a proposal to improve it

decisions.about: Why evaluators are split by group of conditions
decisions.decided: each evaluator judges its group of conditions in its own context, side by side, so a round of evaluators takes as long as its slowest group, and only the groups that hold a condition to judge again start

decisions.about: When a round reaches the orchestrator
decisions.decided: once each evaluator of the round ends: tree.py gives the round's Answers in the orchestrator's News only then, and no orchestrator start for a round in part, as a turn on part of a round decides again once the rest arrive
the orchestrator, at each turn, by inputs first and then by what the run's facts show brings the people closest, and the tree-keeper writes it in the design tree's work

decisions.about: What tree.py holds of the work and the inputs
decisions.decided: tree.py rewrites an item of work whose node a change renames, and refuses a change where an item names no node or comes before a deliverable that its inputs name and that isn't done, or where a deliverable's inputs leave out a kind that its best practice names in inputs

only the user's typed /rn:ty or /rn:gm, whose skill runs tree.py approve or send-back as its own command as it loads, while the guard stops any other call of them; a plugin skill's !`command` runs as the skill loads, in the conversation's folder, with ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} filled in, as a trial on Claude Code 2.1.327 showed

the orchestrator, a subagent started anew at each event of the run, one at a time, rebuilds the run from the design tree and the news since its last turn, keeps the tree true, settles each point but the user's, and orders the work; the main conversation decides nothing: it shows the user each message of the orchestrator word for word, keeps each word of theirs word for word, and starts each role that the guard gives due; the generator makes only what brings the deliverable's people closer; the evaluator finds what's good for them and what would make it good

the orchestrator edits design-tree.json with the Edit tool, and each more it keeps in the round's file with the Write tool; tree.py write checks the tree as edited against the last commit, by form, work, inputs, and each more kept, marks each turn, and commits it with the ground

each role's steps say what holds it, such as reading a best practice whole, carrying out each of its practices, writing only its deliverable, or leaving the design tree unread for the evaluator, and Lane lays the rule that each step's words call for, as Lane's up does; rn's check judges at each end only what no rule of Lane's can: each result against its Cut, and each deliverable against its template, as the user decided on 2026-11-18 that rn's use of Lane comes from Lane's up

tree.py keeps each start's Cut in the run's folder as it gives the start, with the start's result once rn's check keeps it at its end, and every later read takes them from there, so nothing rebuilds a round from git's history
check.py, at each role's end, once it keeps the result, with the result as the message, as no role commits at each step
the goal, the deliverables, and the work order, in the design tree best practice's form

tree.py gives each item of work to make its turn once the deliverable rests on no open point and on nothing not signed off, and the adapters give the start of the first in the work's order that no start holds

no generator or evaluator starts for it: the orchestrator settles each of its decisions, as S2 draws, sets each condition good once its decisions answer it, and puts it up, as S3 draws, so that work resting on it waits for its sign-off

/rn:up alone, where several runs are left, names each and ends; /rn:up with a run's name picks that run up, as Lane's adapter names the work a call picks up from the words typed after the command, so a pick-up never goes the way of a new run

the main conversation stops each role and tree.py pause commits and pushes the work, leaving out an edit of the tree that tree.py write didn't check, as the orchestrator's next turn takes the same news again; each role stopped starts again from its kept Cut

decisions.about: Where a round's best practice and the groups it judges lie
decisions.decided: a new module of tree.py, course, decides each round's best practice, the kind's for content and then the refactor one for structure, two rounds of each at most since the deliverable's latest sign-off sent back, and the groups a round judges: each in a phase's first round, and in a later one each group that holds a condition whose decisions changed since the round before, or, of the refactor one, a condition of a More kept; cut takes the generator's and each evaluator's due round from it

decisions.about: Where the check of inputs lies

turn gives it its turn as any deliverable, and cut gives no start of a generator or an evaluator for it, as the orchestrator settles its decisions

decisions.about: When a round of structure comes

none, as the kind of an input file outside the tree, which tree.py can't tell, is checked by the count of the kinds left, as the decision on the check of inputs says
